From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>

Subject: SIG initiation: follow-up, proposed evidence schedule & next steps

Hi Ella / HealthGrid team,

Thanks again for a productive call this morning — appreciate the context on your timeline and the procurement window. Quick recap and suggested next steps so everyone has a single source of truth: 

Summary from call
- HealthGrid is evaluating Redwood for customer-facing document generation (HIPAA scope) and needs clarity on SOC 2 and evidence collection.
- Procurement indicated a target decision window: mid-April.
- You prefer a lightweight SIG workflow if possible, but will accept CAIQ or custom mapping if necessary.

Proposed next steps
1) I attached a prefill of the standard SIG spreadsheet (redwood_sig_prefill.xlsx) and our SOC 2 high-level summary (SOC2_summary_2026.pdf). Please review and tell us whether you want the full SIG, a CAIQ prefill, or a custom question set.
2) Security Qs: confirm whether HIPAA / BAA is a requirement for initial evaluation or a procurement/contract condition (helps prioritize evidence).
3) Residency: confirm if data must remain in a specific region (you mentioned us-east-1 on the call).
4) Evidence schedule: if you agree, propose we deliver an initial prefill (answers + key artifacts) by next Tue (3/8) and then iterate on any open items the following week.

Owners
- Redwood security lead: Soojin Lee (cc) — will own SIG answers and evidence pull.
- Redwood legal: Kimberly Park (cc) — will confirm BAA / contract language.
- Jordan (me) — sales owner and timeline coordination.

Ask for HealthGrid
- Please confirm: SOC 2 scope you need (e.g., Type II 2026 covering sys & availability?); HIPAA required? preferred questionnaire format (SIG / CAIQ / custom); any evidence owners on your side.
- Also share the procurement contact email if different from procurement@healthgrid.co so we can loop them into any DocuSign/ordering steps.

Attachments: redwood_sig_prefill.xlsx (prefill), SOC2_summary_2026.pdf (audit snapshot)

If that sounds good I’ll schedule a 30-min follow-up with Soojin and Kimberly so we can walk through the prefill and unblock anything technical. Availability Tuesday afternoon would work on our side.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.ai] | +1 415-555-0123

--

- Data residency: we prefer that production data be in us-east-1, but for initial evaluation non-prod artifacts in other regions are OK.

Format: SIG v3 would be preferred by our security team — if you can prefill that, it will speed review. If any fields are missing we can accept CAIQ answers mapped to SIG.

Procurement: procurement@healthgrid.co is the right mailbox for now — I’ll introduce our procurement lead on the next thread if/when we need formal PO language.

Next call: Tue 3/8 afternoon works for me; send a calendar invite.

Subject: Re: SIG initiation: follow-up, proposed evidence schedule & next steps

Hi Ella — welcome, and thanks for the quick confirmation. A couple of clarifying technical questions before we prefill the SIG v3 so we can reduce churn: 

1) HIPAA / BAA scope: is HealthGrid asking that all production PHI be covered under the BAA at launch, or only for certain features (e.g., document generation tied to clinical workflows)? This determines whether we need to pull certain encryption and access evidence immediately.

2) Data residency: you said production in us-east-1 — can you confirm if you require account-level residency (single-tenant/dedicated) or region-level logical residency (multi-tenant but region-located)?

3) Logs & monitoring: do you need continuous push of audit logs to a supplied S3 bucket / syslog endpoint, or are log exports on-demand acceptable? If push is required, we'll need the endpoint and retention spec.

4) Evidence expectations: are you ok with a staged delivery (answers + screenshots/architecture diagrams first, then full artifacts such as policy PDFs and config exports)? Our suggestion to accelerate: deliver answers + architecture + representative artifact set on 3/8, then follow with full artifacts by 3/15.

5) Hosting model: are you evaluating Redwood Hosted API only, or would Dedicated / Private be in scope for procurement? Some evidence differs (e.g., control ownership) depending on hosting.

I’ve attached a cleaned prefill (sig_prefill_v1.xlsx) with placeholders for the items above. If you can quickly answer 1–3, we’ll prefill the rest and send the SIG v3 deck to your team.

Happy to jump on the call 3/8 as well — I can walk through the technical bits and propose the evidence gating.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Security Lead | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
